description: QA bots: fetch your project binding right after your user authorized the TestChimp connector for you (consent page: project picked, "Use this connection as my QA bot" ticked). Returns {projectId, projectName, botId, projectApiKey, userId, settingsUrl}. The connector is your user's and is shared with their other bots, so it does not remember your project: store projectId, projectName, botId and projectApiKey as your own bot-scoped setting (env/secret if your host has one, else bot memory). Then prefer the CLI for TestChimp calls: pipe the key to `testchimp bot save-binding --bot-id <botId> --project-id <projectId>` once per computer, then add --bot <botId> to every command. When you do use these MCP tools, pass projectApiKey and botId on every call. Confirm the project name with your user before storing. Never print projectApiKey.
name: get-bot-credentials
